subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, leaving channel-selective reply routing to existing message-tool policy or a separate API follow-up?
rationale: The source-confirmed command prompt metadata gap is narrow, but adding prompt-driven selective reply routing would change delivery policy and channel/plugin contracts.

options.title: Scope to metadata parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle only.

options.title: Design a selective routing API
options.body: Split or keep a separate product design item for prompt/API semantics around choosing reply channels.

options.title: Rely on existing policy
options.body: Close the broader routing ask as covered by visible-reply/message-tool configuration, accepting that command prompt reconstruction still needs a separate fix if desired.

recommendation.title: Scope to metadata parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle only.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest history-backed ownership of the command prompt bundle and already scoped the same remaining issue in discussion.
